{"id":"com.footy1x.footytools","version":"1.1.12","url":"https://footy1x.store/footytools/FootyTools-1.1.12.zxp","sha256":"bd8f60641522f314925af62c7bdd1f5e2bb4746e028413fff65a135dbc20b7b1","size":414381,"notes":"1.1.12 (26 Oct 2026)
- New look: every tool is an icon tile (three to a row, four on a wide panel). The most-used tools have an
  edge in your accent colour and anything that deletes is red. The tabs are an icon bar along the bottom.
- New layout: 13 tabs, each named for a job, with a line saying what it's for. Colour moved into Look,
  the long Layers tab split into Edit (split, trim, precomp, smart cuts, audio) and Layers, and Render +
  Project became Export. Your work timer is on Home.
- Jump chips at the top of every long tab: tap a section's name to open it and go straight there. Long
  tabs open with their first three sections; the rest stay closed until you need them.
- The Quick bar is one row (scroll it sideways).
- Copy keys / Paste fit: copy keyframes once, paste them on any layer and they stretch or shrink to fit
  that layer from start to end. Paste at playhead keeps the copied timing.
- Cover frames (Export): a PNG at every marker, or frames spread over the work area, to pick a cover from.
- Precomp all: every layer in the comp into one precomp, nothing selected.
- Align to the corners (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right), align starts / ends, put layers
  onto markers, rename text layers after what they say.
- ProRes 422 HQ and ProRes 4444 in one click, and Comp settings, on Export.","published":"2026-10-26"}
